text: Type slash explain 3D, how a speaker makes sound… and you get this. Type slash explode, a game controller… and you get this. Type slash explain 3D, how a microwave heats food… and you get this. Comment SOUND and I'll send you the prompts.

name: montage
text: Your coding agent now makes whole videos. OpenMontage turns Claude Code or Cursor into a video studio. Paste a Short you love, and it plans one like it, with the cost first. A live board shows the script, the scenes and every dollar spent. Nothing renders until you approve the storyboard. AI clips cost money, free footage doesn't. Comment MONTAGE and I'll send you the link.
